lines.name: 1-card: Magician's Rod → Destruction + Chaos Angel + Dragoon

steps.text: Normal Summon Magician's Rod. Its effect adds Dark Magical Curtain.

branches.response: No Curtain. Rod stays on the field; play a second starter if you hold one (Pharaoh's Servant + a Spell, Apprentice + a discard, or Illusion of Chaos). With Rod alone, end on Rod and keep hand traps.
Same as Ash: Rod's search is negated. Go into your second starter, or end on Rod.

Droll after Rod's search stops further adds from the Deck. Curtain still summons Dark Magician (no search); summon Dark Magician of Destruction anyway for a body. End on Destruction + Rod with hand traps.

steps.text: Activate Dark Magical Curtain: Special Summon Dark Magician from your Deck (it can't activate effects this turn; your opponent may also summon a DARK Spellcaster). Because it's Dark Magician, add The Gaze of Timaeus.

branches.response: Curtain is negated, so no Dark Magician and no Gaze. Rod has used its search; end on Rod, or go into a second starter.

If they Maxx 'C' (or Mulcharmy Fuwalos) on this Special Summon, every Special Summon from here draws them a card. Stop early: make Dark Magician of Destruction (search Pharaoh's Servant for next turn) and use Gaze on it for Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon; end on Dragoon + Rod.
Ogre destroys Curtain on the field but its effect still resolves; continue as normal.

steps.text: Special Summon Dark Magician of Destruction from the Extra Deck by banishing Dark Magician (a Spell was activated this turn). Its effect adds Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant.

branches.response: No Servant. Use Gaze on Dark Magician of Destruction (it's named Dark Magician on the field) to Fusion Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon. End on Dragoon + Rod.

steps.text: Reveal The Gaze of Timaeus and Special Summon Pharaoh's Servant from your hand; Set The Gaze of Timaeus from your Deck.
Synchro Summon Chaos Angel using Pharaoh's Servant and Magician's Rod, treating Rod as the Tuner (7 + 3 = 10). Both materials are DARK, so your monsters can't be destroyed by battle.

branches.response: Nibiru tributes your monsters. Pharaoh's Servant is still Dark Magician in the GY, so activate Gaze from your hand targeting it and Fusion Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon; it can negate later effects.

steps.text: Activate The Gaze of Timaeus from your hand targeting Pharaoh's Servant in the GY (it's named Dark Magician there): shuffle it into the Deck to Fusion Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon.

lines.endBoardText: Dragoon negates once (discard 1); the set Gaze summons another Fusion on their turn (Master of Chaos off Destruction); Chaos Angel stops battle destruction.
lines.notes: Keep at least 1 card in hand for Dragoon's discard. Magician's Rod in the GY returns to your hand on their turn when you activate the set Gaze (Tribute a Spellcaster).

lines.name: 1-card: Illusion of Chaos → Rod line

steps.text: Reveal Illusion of Chaos: add Magician's Rod, then place Illusion of Chaos on top of your Deck.

branches.response: No Rod. Keep Illusion in hand and play another starter if you have one.
Droll after Illusion's search locks the Deck: Normal Summon Rod for a body only. End on Rod.

steps.text: Normal Summon Magician's Rod. Its effect adds Dark Magical Curtain.

branches.response: Rod's search is negated. End on Rod, or use a second starter.

steps.text: Activate Dark Magical Curtain: Special Summon Dark Magician from your Deck, then add The Gaze of Timaeus.

branches.response: If they Maxx 'C' (or Mulcharmy Fuwalos) on this Special Summon, every Special Summon from here draws them a card. Stop early: Destruction → Gaze for Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon; end on Dragoon + Rod.

steps.text: Special Summon Dark Magician of Destruction by banishing Dark Magician; add Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant.

branches.response: Use Gaze on Dark Magician of Destruction for Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon; end on Dragoon + Rod.

steps.text: Reveal The Gaze of Timaeus to Special Summon Pharaoh's Servant; Set The Gaze of Timaeus from your Deck.
Synchro Summon Chaos Angel with Pharaoh's Servant + Magician's Rod (Rod treated as the Tuner).
Activate The Gaze of Timaeus from your hand targeting Pharaoh's Servant in the GY: Fusion Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon.

lines.endBoardText: Same board as the Rod line. Illusion goes back on top of the Deck, so it's your next draw.
lines.notes: If you'd rather keep Illusion in hand, place a dead card on top instead.

lines.name: Apprentice + 1 card → Sarcophagus, Destruction, Chaos Angel, Dragoon
starters: Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice

steps.text: Discard 1 card to Special Summon Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice. Its effect adds Shining Sarcophagus.

activations.card: Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice

summons.card: Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice

branches.response: No Sarcophagus. Normal Summon Magician's Rod if you have it and play the Rod line; otherwise end on Apprentice.

If they Maxx 'C' (or Mulcharmy Fuwalos) on this Special Summon, every Special Summon from here draws them a card. Stop early: take Shining Sarcophagus, Special Summon Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic, and end on Apprentice + Black Magic + Sarcophagus.
Droll after the Sarcophagus search: activate Sarcophagus (its own search is now blocked). End on Apprentice + Sarcophagus.

steps.text: Activate Shining Sarcophagus, then use its effect to add Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic.

moves.card: Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic

branches.response: Shining Sarcophagus can't be destroyed by monster effects, so Ogre does nothing; continue.

steps.text: Special Summon Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic from your hand (Shining Sarcophagus is on the field).

activations.card: Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic

summons.card: Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic

steps.text: Special Summon Dark Magician of Destruction by banishing the Apprentice (a Spell was activated this turn). Its effect adds Magician's Rod.

materials: Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice

branches.response: No Rod. Normal Summon is still free: end on Destruction + Black Magic with Sarcophagus up, and keep your hand traps.

steps.text: Normal Summon Magician's Rod. Its effect adds Dark Magical Curtain.
Activate Dark Magical Curtain: Special Summon Dark Magician from your Deck, then add The Gaze of Timaeus.

branches.response: This is your 5th summon. If Nibiru wipes the field, Gaze can still target Dark Magician of Destruction or Dark Magician in the GY for Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon.

steps.text: Synchro Summon Chaos Angel with Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic + Magician's Rod (Rod treated as the Tuner).

materials: Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic

steps.text: Activate The Gaze of Timaeus targeting Dark Magician on your field: shuffle it into the Deck to Fusion Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon. A Normal Monster was its material, so Dragoon can destroy 1 monster and burn each turn.

lines.endBoardText: Dragoon negates once (discard 1) and can destroy + burn once per turn; Sarcophagus can send a monster they revive from the GY to the GY (discard a Spell).
lines.notes: Needs one card to discard for the Apprentice. Gaze banishes Dragoon at the End Phase of your NEXT turn.

lines.name: 1-card + discard: Future Silence → Apprentice line

steps.text: Activate Future Silence: add Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice.

moves.card: Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice

branches.response: No search. Play another starter if you hold one.
Droll after Future Silence's search locks the Deck: Special Summon the Apprentice (no Sarcophagus search) and end there.

steps.text: Discard 1 card to Special Summon the Apprentice; add Shining Sarcophagus.

activations.card: Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice

summons.card: Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice

branches.response: If they Maxx 'C' (or Mulcharmy Fuwalos) on this Special Summon, every Special Summon from here draws them a card. Stop early: end on Apprentice + Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic + Sarcophagus.

steps.text: Activate Shining Sarcophagus; add Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic.

moves.card: Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic

steps.text: Special Summon Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic from your hand.

activations.card: Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic

summons.card: Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic

steps.text: Special Summon Dark Magician of Destruction by banishing the Apprentice; add Magician's Rod.

materials: Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice

steps.text: Normal Summon Magician's Rod; add Dark Magical Curtain.
Activate Dark Magical Curtain: Special Summon Dark Magician from your Deck; add The Gaze of Timaeus.
Synchro Summon Chaos Angel with Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic + Magician's Rod (Rod as the Tuner).

materials: Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic

steps.text: Gaze of Timaeus on Dark Magician: Fusion Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon.

lines.endBoardText: Same board as the Apprentice line.
lines.notes: Future Silence only draws for both players in the Battle Phase; in Main Phase 1 it's just a search.

lines.name: Pharaoh's Servant + a Spell → Destruction, Chaos Angel, Dragoon

steps.text: Reveal a Spell in your hand to Special Summon Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant; Set Dark Magical Circle from your Deck.

branches.response: If they Maxx 'C' (or Mulcharmy Fuwalos) on this Special Summon, every Special Summon from here draws them a card. Stop early: activate Circle, summon Dark Magician of Destruction (search Rod), then Normal Summon Rod for Curtain only if you still want Chaos Angel; otherwise end on Destruction + Circle.

steps.text: Activate the Set Dark Magical Circle: look at the top 3 cards and add Dark Magician or a Spell/Trap that mentions it if one is there.
Special Summon Dark Magician of Destruction by banishing Pharaoh's Servant (a Spell was activated). Its effect adds Magician's Rod.

branches.response: No Rod. Dark Magical Circle banishes when Dark Magician is summoned; end on Destruction + Circle and keep your hand traps.

steps.text: Normal Summon Magician's Rod; add Dark Magical Curtain.
Activate Dark Magical Curtain: Special Summon Dark Magician from your Deck; add The Gaze of Timaeus.
Synchro Summon Chaos Angel with Dark Magician + Magician's Rod (Rod as the Tuner).

branches.response: If Nibiru tributes your field, Gaze can still target Dark Magician in the GY for Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon.

steps.text: Activate The Gaze of Timaeus targeting Dark Magician in the GY: Fusion Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon (a Normal Monster was its material, so it can destroy + burn).

lines.endBoardText: Dragoon negates once (discard 1) and can destroy + burn; Circle banishes a card whenever a Dark Magician is summoned on a later turn.
lines.notes: Needs any Spell in hand to reveal (it stays in hand). Circle's top-3 look is luck; the line doesn't depend on it.

lines.name: 1-card: Dark Magical Curtain → Destruction + Dragoon

steps.text: Activate Dark Magical Curtain: Special Summon Dark Magician from your Deck; add The Gaze of Timaeus.

branches.response: Nothing is summoned. Use your Normal Summon on another starter if you have one.

If they Maxx 'C' (or Mulcharmy Fuwalos) on this Special Summon, every Special Summon from here draws them a card. Stop early: summon Dark Magician of Destruction (search Pharaoh's Servant) and Gaze it into Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon; end on Dragoon.

steps.text: Special Summon Dark Magician of Destruction by banishing Dark Magician; add Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant.

branches.response: Gaze on Dark Magician of Destruction for Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon; end on Dragoon.

steps.text: Reveal The Gaze of Timaeus to Special Summon Pharaoh's Servant; Set The Gaze of Timaeus from your Deck.
Activate The Gaze of Timaeus from your hand targeting Pharaoh's Servant (named Dark Magician on the field): Fusion Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon.

lines.endBoardText: Dragoon negates once (discard 1); the set Gaze can make Master of Chaos off Destruction on their turn. Normal Summon is still free for a Magician's Rod if you draw or hold one.
lines.notes: With Magician's Rod also in hand, Normal Summon it before step 4 and use the Rod line instead for Chaos Angel as well.

lines.name: 2-card: Magician's Rod + Apprentice → Destruction, Servant, Chaos Angel, Dragoon
starters: Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice

steps.text: Discard 1 card to Special Summon Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice; add Shining Sarcophagus.

activations.card: Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice

summons.card: Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice

branches.response: No Sarcophagus. Normal Summon Rod and play the Rod line from its first step (Curtain → Dark Magician → Gaze); the Apprentice can be banished for Dark Magician of Destruction once Curtain resolves.
Every Special Summon draws them a card. Normal Summon Rod for Curtain, then Gaze for Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon and stop: end on Apprentice + Rod + Dragoon.

steps.text: Activate Shining Sarcophagus; add Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic.

moves.card: Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic

branches.response: Sarcophagus can't be destroyed by monster effects; continue.

steps.text: Special Summon Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic from your hand.

activations.card: Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic

summons.card: Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic

steps.text: Special Summon Dark Magician of Destruction by banishing the Apprentice; add Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant.

materials: Dark Magician Girl the Magician's Apprentice

steps.text: Normal Summon Magician's Rod; add Dark Magical Curtain.

branches.response: No more adds from the Deck. Synchro Chaos Angel with Black Magic + Rod and end on Destruction + Chaos Angel + Sarcophagus.

steps.text: Activate Dark Magical Curtain: Special Summon Dark Magician from your Deck; add The Gaze of Timaeus.
Reveal The Gaze of Timaeus to Special Summon Pharaoh's Servant; Set The Gaze of Timaeus from your Deck.
Synchro Summon Chaos Angel with Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic + Magician's Rod (Rod treated as the Tuner).

materials: Dark Magician the Magician of Black Magic

steps.text: Activate The Gaze of Timaeus from your hand targeting Dark Magician on your field: Fusion Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon (Normal Monster material, so it can destroy + burn).

lines.endBoardText: Dragoon negates once (discard 1) and can destroy + burn; the set Gaze makes Master of Chaos on their turn; Sarcophagus answers GY revivals; Chaos Angel stops battle destruction.
lines.notes: Needs 1 card to discard for the Apprentice and keep 1 card for Dragoon's discard. Pharaoh's Servant used its effect this turn, so its Spell/Trap wipe is only available from your next turn.

lines.name: 2-card: Magicians' Souls + Magician's Rod → Destruction, Chaos Angel, Dragoon

steps.text: Activate Magicians' Souls in hand: send Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant from your Deck to the GY, then send Souls to the GY.

branches.response: Nothing is sent. Play the Rod line from its first step.

steps.text: …and Special Summon Pharaoh's Servant from the GY (it's named Dark Magician there).

branches.response: Every further Special Summon draws them a card. Normal Summon Rod for Curtain, then Gaze on Pharaoh's Servant for Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon; end on Dragoon + Rod + Dark Magician.

steps.text: Normal Summon Magician's Rod; add Dark Magical Curtain.

branches.response: No Curtain. Synchro Chaos Angel with Pharaoh's Servant + Rod; end on Chaos Angel.

steps.text: Activate Dark Magical Curtain: Special Summon Dark Magician from your Deck; add The Gaze of Timaeus.
Special Summon Dark Magician of Destruction by banishing Dark Magician; add Illusion of Chaos.

branches.response: The search is stopped; continue from the next step (it doesn't need the Deck).

steps.text: Synchro Summon Chaos Angel with Pharaoh's Servant + Magician's Rod (Rod treated as the Tuner).
Activate The Gaze of Timaeus targeting Pharaoh's Servant in the GY: Fusion Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon.

lines.endBoardText: Dragoon negates once (discard 1); Chaos Angel stops battle destruction. Illusion of Chaos in hand searches again next turn.
lines.notes: Magicians' Souls' second option is 'send this card to the GY, then you can Special Summon Dark Magician from your GY'; Pharaoh's Servant counts because its name is Dark Magician in the GY.
